description:
## Tantan 7.5.4 — GMS hook performance cleanup (best-effort)

- Removed Parcel.mCreators/sPairedCreators global CREATOR-cache clearing from signature-spoof init (eliminates app-wide Parcelable reflection/allocation churn; unnecessary for signature spoofing)
- Cached spoofed certificate bytes (no per-call allocation in hasSigningCertificate)
- Retained prior wave: removed main-thread GC/sleep startup stall, cached SigningInfo fast path, removed per-query log spam, allocation-free list filters, restored functional Messages cell binds (fixes 'Matched %s' placeholder)
- On-device profiling: UI renders fast (~1.5ms frames); Messages delay is a data-load wait, not patch CPU work
- All 16 patches apply to 7.5.4 (2754010)
